spec.headline: Fragmented Collateral vs. Unified Margin
spec.subhead: Isolated pools restrict capital efficiency. SmartAccounts assess health across your entire portfolio.

blocks.text: Isolated Pools: Collateral is fragmented across separate deposits for every borrow, trapping capital in silos.
Vanna SmartAccount: One collateral balance backs multiple positions, evaluated across the entire account.
Siloed Risk Exposure: Each borrow position is liquidated independently, restricting overall borrowing power.
Cross-Portfolio Health: Account-level risk evaluation protects positions and maximizes capital efficiency.

focal.reason: Directs immediate visual focus to the primary unified SmartAccount value proposition with strong primary emphasis.

defects.issue: Unbalanced vertical distribution leaving dead negative space at the bottom
defects.reason: The entire layout terminates at roughly y: 760px, leaving more than 300px of completely unanchored dead background that makes the composition feel top-heavy and unfinished.
defects.fix: Shift the entire content container down by 80px and increase vertical gap between the subheadline and comparison grid from 48px to 72px.

defects.issue: Lack of typographic hierarchy in comparison columns
defects.location: Comparison section (both left and right columns)
defects.reason: Titles ('Isolated Pools:', 'Vanna SmartAccount:', 'Siloed Risk Exposure:', 'Cross-Portfolio Health:') are run inline with descriptive body copy at identical type size and weight, forcing the viewer to read rather than scan.
defects.fix: Break the titles onto their own line above the body copy, set them in 600 weight with 12px bottom spacing before the explanatory text.

defects.issue: Intended focal element lacks distinct prominence
defects.reason: While the right column has higher contrast text than the left, block #1 blends directly into the block below it with no surface container, accent pill, or structural separation to command immediate focus.
defects.fix: Enclose the right column in a subtle card container (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) fill with a 1px border at rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)) to establish clear focal gravity.
